item.title: Overworld 0.4.0
item.description:
• The notice board in town now shows a small tally on its face: a slip for each house with a pin in that house's door colour, strokes for residents working (charcoal) and asleep (grey), and a brass mark when a bell is ringing. Clicking the board opens the Board card. The planting in front hides most of it at the default view, so zoom or pan to read it.
  • The commons shows the four most relevant residents: ringing bells first, then working, then idle, newest first. The others are counted in the Hall. The Mac app's list uses the same order.
  • One resident with damaged data no longer stops the rest of the town from drawing.
  • A resident whose house can't be found walks home instead of vanishing.
